unproven: Exact authenticated request contract that accepts private audio, including method/content type/body shape and required auth context.
Served runtime identity that implements that private-audio request contract.
Successful authenticated ingestion of one bounded private-audio sample through that served contract.
Non-empty transcription result for that request without persisting transcript/audio into Prometeo evidence.
Zero unintended persistence/retention of raw audio, provisional text, session identifiers or credentials in evidence/logs.

separate_deployment_boundary.truth_boundary: The read-only bounded probe deliberately sends no audio and therefore cannot establish private-audio acceptance even after deployment.

preconditions: Resolve the authoritative authenticated private-audio request shape from source/runtime owner evidence.
Record served function version/digest before sending the test.
Use one bounded ephemeral audio sample whose raw bytes remain outside Prometeo evidence.
future_runtime_test_contract.pass_rule: PASS only when the resolved authenticated private-audio contract is served, one bounded request succeeds, a non-empty transcription is returned, and the durable receipt contains only allowed sanitized metadata.
future_runtime_test_contract.fail_closed_rule: If request shape, served identity, auth authority, or privacy behavior cannot be proven, emit SOURCE_BOUNDARY/AUTH_BOUNDARY instead of inferring acceptance from synthetic browser audio, handler liveness, or selftest probes.

next_required_source: Authoritative source/runtime evidence defining the authenticated private-audio request contract. Current evidence only defines liveness and no-audio selftest shapes.
prohibited_inference: Do not infer private-audio acceptance from synthetic browser transcription.
Do not infer private-audio acceptance from HTTP 200 handler liveness.
Do not infer private-audio acceptance from GET ?selftest=probe because it sends no audio.
Do not store private audio or verbatim transcript in Prometeo receipts.
